summary: Pulse Biosciences, Inc. disclosed an equity distribution agreement with Mizuho Securities USA LLC, enabling at-the-market sales of common stock up to $75 million. The company is not obligated to sell; Mizuho acts as agent with a 3% commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation. No premium, valuation, or unusual structural elements are present. Watch for potential dilution on future sales, but no special-situation angle applies.
